articles.summary: DALLAS (October 6, 2026) — AECOM (NYSE:ACM), the trusted global infrastructure leader, today announced an AECOM-led joint venture, 413 Continuity Partners, has been awarded the Highway 413 Program Management Consultant contract by the Ministry of Transportation of Ontario (MTO). Highway 413 is a transformative transportation program that will create a new, approximately 59-kilometer transportation corridor...
articles.title: AECOM-led joint venture appointed as program management consultant for Ontario’s Highway 413
